enchantments.tooltip: Sight Beyond Sight: You can see through all veils, piercing magical and mundane defenses alike. +5% Enhancement bonus to Dodge bypass.
Eversight: You benefit from the spell True Seeing and are Immune to Blindness.
Pierce Cold Iron: Provides the Pierce Cold Iron feat, allowing your equipped weapons to break Cold Iron DR.
Spell Save +11: This item gives a +11 Resistance bonus to your saves versus spells.
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
